name: comp-377
title: Avatar Account Menu
description: An avatar with a chevron in a site header opens an account menu. The menu shows the user's name and email, then Profile, Billing, Settings, Team, Documentation and Logout.
use: A signed-in header needs quick access to profile, billing and logout without a sidebar.
avoid: The avatar trigger is small and the menu is fixed narrow, so long names or emails get truncated.
a11y: The trigger has an aria-label and the menu follows standard menu roles with arrow keys; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark header bar holds the word Acme, three grey nav labels and, at the right, a small round photo with a chevron. Clicking it opens a dark menu aligned to the right edge: a bold name over a grey email, then two groups of icon rows and a Logout row, split by thin rules.
behaves: Clicking the avatar opens the menu; hovering a row highlights it and choosing one closes the menu. Clicking outside or pressing Escape dismisses it.
customise: The user name, email, avatar URL and every menu label are fixed in the file; the trigger and menu alignment are set in code.
weight: light: A small menu with one avatar image; nothing runs until opened.
demo: 'Acme' header with Dashboard, Projects, Reports; menu shows Keith Kennedy and Profile, Billing, Settings, Team, Logout.
issues: The menu is a fixed 240px wide, so long names and emails are truncated.
Menu items have no actions wired; choosing one only closes the menu.
polishWhy: Clean header and tidy menu; it is a conventional account dropdown.
